vulnerability_title: [M-03] Price cumulative last is used inverted in Uniswap Oracle

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: validatePrice reads price1CumulativeLast when direction is 0 and price0CumulativeLast when direction is 1, which is the inverted choice the finding describes. The surrounding TWAP formula also cancels this value out, which hides the effect but does not remove the inverted line.
patterns_found: direction == 0 reads price1CumulativeLast and direction == 1 reads price0CumulativeLast
issues: In this version the TWAP formula adds tradePrice * elapsedTime to cumulativePriceLast and then subtracts cumulativePriceLast again, so the deviation is always zero whichever cumulative value is read. The inverted selection is present, but a second flaw hides its numeric effect.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: inverted Uniswap V2 cumulative price in the TWAP check
